title: Power-8 — Near-Undetectable SpoofStack Iteration
goal: Iterate spoofed snapshot until ProbeRunner.aggregate.category == CLEAN against the FULL implemented probe inventory (all 63 probes, not just the 26 in the current test panel). Produce a production SpoofStack hook spec mapping every snapshot mutation to a real ReDroid host modification (Magisk service.d / LSPosed module / mount-mask / kernel module). Final deliverable: status report quantifying detection-resistance (% probes verifiably masked, residual surface, un-spoofable rationale).
testStrategy: Each iteration: write full-ProbeRunner test → builder mutates snapshot → reviewer static-traces → re-run. Loop until criticalFailures==0 AND no probe in the full panel scores > 0.5. Acceptance = full ProbeRunner returns ReportCategory.CLEAN.

phases.name: Full-panel baseline against current spoofed snapshot
deliverables: FullProbeRunnerSpoofTest.kt that instantiates ALL 63 implementable probes
audit/spoof-stack/iter-N-baseline.md — table of which-fire with score
Categorize fires: (a) snapshot-fixable, (b) probe-quality-bug (host JVM), (c) constructor-supplier (not on ProbeContext), (d) inherently un-snapshottable

phases.name: Close (a) snapshot-fixable fires
deliverables: Updated RedroidSpoofedSnapshot.kt mutations for each fire in bucket (a)

phases.name: Close (b) probe-quality-bugs via ProbeContext refactor
deliverables: TimezoneLocaleProbe + LanguageCountryProbe refactored to read from ProbeContext.getTimeZone() / getLocale() (new default-methods)

phases.name: Close (c) constructor-supplier fires via the bluetoothMac pattern
deliverables: For each (c) probe: add a queryX() default-method on ProbeContext, override on SnapshotReplayContext, add a snapshot field if needed

phases.name: Document (d) un-snapshottable surface
deliverables: audit/spoof-stack/un-snapshottable.md — rationale per probe, with the real-runtime hook needed
Most likely: WebView fingerprints (rank 54-56), GPS coordinates (rank 41 — needs LocationManager mock), NetworkType ASN (rank 5 — needs network)

phases.name: Production SpoofStack hook specification
deliverables: audit/spoof-stack/production-hooks-spec.md — for each snapshot mutation, the exact Magisk module / LSPosed hook / service.d script that supplies the value on PAR822349
Hook categories: resetprop (build-props), service.d (settings.put), LSPosed (Java API spoofing), file mount (sysfs spoofing)

phases.name: Detection-resistance status report
deliverables: Quantified: X / 63 probes verifiably masked; Y residual implementation; Z un-spoofable
Risk assessment: what could a sophisticated detector still catch?

validationCriteria: Full ProbeRunner against RedroidSpoofedSnapshot returns ReportCategory.CLEAN
Production hooks doc covers every snapshot mutation
Status report quantifies coverage with hard numbers
